title: 'success has become a proxy for integrity'
summary: Burger hosts a leadership podcast and reads the book against a moment when organisations let leaders cut corners and act untouchable. She takes the point that this is structural, and adds that structure still needs leaders who handle power with care.
attribution_title: Founder and host, The New Work Playbook
blockquote: We're living in a world where power lets leaders deflect accountability, and success has become a proxy for integrity.
